description: Java class for monitoring network connectivity during Android monkey testing, tracking Wi-Fi and mobile network usage over time.

classes.name: MonkeyNetworkMonitor
classes.description: Monitors network connectivity changes and tracks elapsed time on Wi-Fi and mobile networks during monkey test runs.

methods.name: performReceive
methods.description: Handles network change intents, updates network stats based on network state.

methods.name: updateNetworkStats
methods.description: Calculates time spent on mobile and Wi-Fi networks since last update.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes timing variables and starts data collection.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the receiver with the activity manager to listen for network changes.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the receiver from the activity manager.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Updates network stats at the end of data collection.
